Definition: {to prophesy, i.e. speak (or sing) by inspiration (in prediction or simple discourse) to prophesy, i.e. speak (or sing) by inspiration (in prediction or simple discourse)}
BiblicalUsage: Haggai and Zechariah prophesy to the Jews while the temple is being rebuilt — the one place the Aramaic word for prophesying is heard.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the rebuilding waited on the prophesying: the word came first, and the work followed, because God's house is built by His word before it is built by hands.
